Re-review: I am using the same product for the past 6 years. I stay outside home, hence I use it daily for making tea, oats, maggi, pasta, boiled egg, etc. This product is by far the best in the market by its category. Three of my friends have also bought it from my suggestions. They are also using the same for more than three years. So, you can blindly buy this product of Prestige.

This has been extremely useful at home... Quickly make hotwater/tea in your bedroom without a trip to the kitchen. 

Pros: 
. Open lid - easy to clean. 
. Glass lid - easy to see thru
. Wire length- sufficient at almost 100cm ( other brands are short - 60cm)
. Build quality is good as you would expect from prestige. 

Cons:
Nothing so far. Yet to note the power consumption. 

Note that there are few prestige duplicates as well in flipkart... be cautious. Those will just have a prestige sticker  on a generic water kettle.
